title: Gochujang-Style Spicy Pork Stir Fry with Onions
summary: A Korean-inspired dairy-free pork stir fry with sweet onions, garlic, ginger and a spicy chilli-miso sauce standing in for gochujang. It is quick, glossy, savoury-sweet and ideal for a weeknight dinner with rice.

ingredients.name: miso paste, as a gochujang-style fermented base

steps: Stir the miso, sriracha, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil and black pepper together in a small bowl until smooth and glossy.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the sliced onions with the salt and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes, until softened and lightly browned at the edges.
Add the pork mince and break it up with a spatula. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until no pink remains and the pork is beginning to brown.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant but not burnt.
Pour in the spicy miso sauce and toss well to coat the pork and onions. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the sauce thickens, clings to the meat and looks glossy.
Stir through most of the spring onions, then remove from the heat. Taste and adjust with a little more salt if needed.
Serve hot, scattered with sesame seeds and the remaining spring onions.
